summary: Several metrics exhibit simultaneous extreme deviations at 2026-08-28T14:07:00Z, including query latency, client retries, error rate, and pod readiness failures, with a preceding rise in active DB connections. The error rate surpasses the 90% threshold and shows a large period change. High positive correlations among these metrics indicate they moved together during the observed window.

evidence.interpretation: ledger_query_duration_ms spiked to 10000 ms, far above its baseline mean of ~3.5 ms.
client_retries_sec jumped to 120 seconds, a dramatic increase from a baseline of 0 s.
error_rate_pct spiked to 100 %, indicating total failures during the sample.
active_db_conns rose to 15, well above its baseline mean of ~2.3 connections.
pod_readiness_failures increased to 5 failures, whereas the baseline is 0.
error_rate_pct reached 100 %, exceeding the defined 90 % threshold.
error_rate_pct shifted from a baseline mean of 0 % to an average of 47 % in the period, a delta of 47 %.
pod readiness failures and error rate are almost perfectly positively correlated (Pearson r≈0.997) over the 7‑sample window.
